canonical_bindings.domain: competency_domains (resolve existing slugs; retain historical applied-ai domain)
canonical_bindings.course_and_version: Batch 1 adds curriculum course/version metadata; no duplicate enrollment engine
canonical_bindings.project: existing project definitions, projects and submission commands
canonical_bindings.evidence: existing evidence, reviews, verified_skills and reviewer decisions
canonical_bindings.workflow: existing versioned workflow definitions, dispatcher, work items and learner coordinator
canonical_bindings.audit: existing append-only audit ledger; session callers cannot write arbitrary events
canonical_bindings.files: file_objects with existing ownership and storage authorization

batch_1_required_extensions: Pin enrollment, attempts, completions and evidence to immutable curriculum versions; a new version receives new module/activity IDs.
Persist private lesson assessment keys and append-only practice/assessment attempts. Do not reuse or expose baseline answer keys for unrelated lesson tests.
Replace completion-by-click for catalog lessons with the specified server-authoritative gates, keeping existing learner history intact.
Store video assets once and lesson mappings separately; metadata/health verification is independent of learner watch progress.
Exclude draft-only competencies from generated learning plans until deliverable published content exists.
Publish through a transaction that validates content, video requirements, prerequisites, assessments and project mappings, and writes a reasoned audit event.
Wire curriculum assessment failures to existing workflow work items for remediation and instructor intervention, without creating another workflow engine.

identity.instructor: Explicitly granted combination of content authority, cohort visibility and review authority; never infer one privilege from another.

publication.approval_actor: authorized content operator distinct from student
required_checks: verified required video and render test
publication.pending_video: block publication when video_required; keep text preview available to authorized authors
publication.retired_version: existing authorized enrollment retains its pinned content and evidence; no new enrollment

video.unavailable_behavior: Show explanation, retain lesson text and saved work, offer verified source link when safe; block only required-video completion.
video.captions_policy: Capture actual caption availability; require an accessible equivalent reviewed by content staff before publication.

progress.source: server-validated bounded playback intervals tied to session, enrollment and pinned lesson

practice.persistence: append-only attempts and evaluations; retain the content hash and version of every submitted artifact
practice.interruption: save draft and resume without creating accepted evidence
practice.AI: advisory feedback only, recorded with model/provider/policy/input references; never silently accepted as review

assessment.responses: append-only on submission; changes require a new attempt

grading.multi_select: set equality, no partial credit unless explicitly versioned
grading.project: claimed independent reviewer and required competency checks

assessment.private_keys: No student table grant, API projection or tutor context may include keys or protected rubrics.
assessment.feedback: Only after own attempt is submitted and evaluated; give objective-level feedback without revealing protected answers during an active retry.
assessment.retries: Three attempts per cycle; remediation before each retry; an audited instructor intervention can open a new cycle without changing old results.
assessment.AI_grading: Advisory, provenance retained, human decision required for authoritative rubric results.

progression.lesson: pinned published version + enrollment + prerequisites + instruction acknowledgement + required verified video threshold + accepted practice + passed checkpoint (+ approved project for project lessons)
progression.module: all required lessons and designated module checkpoint passed
progression.course: all required modules and domain project approved
progression.mastery: approved evidence and required competency checks; do not infer from viewing, course attendance or AI statements
progression.credential: all versioned requirements and qualifying non-revoked evidence; idempotent issuance
progression.completion_transaction: lock enrollment/attempt; verify persisted gates; insert completion once; update canonical progress; audit; signal existing workflow

diagnostic_and_plan.baseline: server-graded diagnostic responses produce baseline evidence and competency estimates, not verified project mastery
diagnostic_and_plan.learner_choice: accept or change recommended track; changing a track creates a new plan version and preserves history
diagnostic_and_plan.explanation: Name the target capability, observed baseline/evidence gap, prerequisite chain and reason for the proposed activity.
diagnostic_and_plan.unavailable_content: show explicit content-unavailable status; do not enroll or claim a feasible next activity

remediation.missing_segment: use authored section and worked example; never invent a timestamp
remediation.intervention: after retry limit, create scoped human work item; approval of a new cycle does not grant a passing grade

tutor.active_protected_assessment: policy-approved conceptual hints only; no direct answers
tutor.outage: record unavailable turn; preserve learner work; provide approved static lesson guidance

portfolio.source: approved project → evidence → verified competencies → learner-selected entry
portfolio.visibility: private by default; learner controls authorized sharing
portfolio.revoked_evidence: update visible verification state; do not leave a verified claim unsupported

analytics.metrics: derive from persisted canonical events; distinguish engagement from completion and completion from mastery

retention_accessibility.retention: Set an approved policy per artifact class; no indefinite retention inferred from this specification.
retention_accessibility.privacy: Minimize transcript, tutor and analytics data; scope reads and redact secrets.
accessibility: non-video instructional route when an approved accommodation exists
retention_accessibility.accommodation: authorized documented equivalent assessment, never a student-side completion bypass

representative_journeys.certification_rule: Run against real persisted state and a verified video in Batch 2; a reference-policy test is not a browser E2E certification.

negative_cases.trigger: Required lesson has no verified asset
negative_cases.expected: Block publication/completion; retain draft and show pending source.
Record failed health check, preserve text/progress, offer safe recovery; no fabricated watch credit.

negative_cases.trigger: Source plays externally but embedding is denied
negative_cases.expected: Keep needs_review and block required-video publication until approved alternative exists.

negative_cases.trigger: Progress or attempt request loses its response
negative_cases.expected: Retry with the same request ID; restore acknowledged state; never double-count.
One durable event and interval union; no additional credit.
Return original submission; create no duplicate review or evidence.

negative_cases.trigger: Two tabs start the same assessment version
negative_cases.expected: One active attempt; return existing attempt or a conflict, never two active rows.
Resume saved draft; no grade or completion until submitted and evaluated.

negative_cases.trigger: Tutor is asked for the active test answer
negative_cases.expected: Refuse direct answer; log policy outcome; offer approved conceptual hint.

negative_cases.trigger: Provider fails during tutoring or advisory feedback
negative_cases.expected: Preserve attempts; mark turn unavailable; use approved static guidance.

negative_cases.trigger: Client submits for a different version than enrollment
negative_cases.expected: Reject mismatch; keep original history; show pinned version or authorized migration route.

negative_cases.trigger: Client calls completion on a locked lesson
negative_cases.expected: Server denies; no progress, evidence or audit claim of completion.

negative_cases.trigger: Learner attempts a direct skill-level write
negative_cases.expected: Database denies; qualifying evidence remains unchanged.

negative_cases.trigger: Learner invokes a private issuance helper
Learner requests another learner attempt or artifact
negative_cases.expected: RLS/API deny without exposing protected content.
Deny unless an explicit scoped grant exists.

negative_cases.trigger: Learner reloads during or after a completed activity
negative_cases.expected: Restore persisted pinned state; do not create another attempt or completion.
